en: A vintage black and white postcard with a collage of photographs showing panoramic street views, grand hotels, spa colonnades, and ornate architecture surrounded by forested hills. Several famous locations are labeled, such as Mühlbrunnkolonnade, Hotel Imperial, Parkhotel Pupp, and Kurhaus u. Mühlbrunn. The central area has a tower and arcade structure labeled Marktbrunn. The main inscriptions say 'Weltbad Karlsbad.'
